description: Use for a triathlon or other multisport recording. Lists the legs, checks whether a separate recording (for example a bike computer file, legActivityIds) matches a leg and proposes splicing it in, and proposes moving transitions to official split times the user gives (officialBoundaries, elapsed seconds from the start) or to a matched leg's own start or end (never ticked: a late start press is as likely as a late lap press). The engine cannot split one session into several. Nothing is changed by this call, and nothing that alters heart rate or any other data is applied without the user's confirmation. Show the user every step whose needsUserConfirmation is true, with its title, reason and changes, and get an explicit yes; then call apply_plan with exactly the confirmed step ids. Relay findings and notes in plain words. If refusal is set, tell the user why and do not offer a workaround the answer does not give.

legActivityIds.description: Up to 3 separate recordings of single legs (for example a bike computer file). Must not include activityId.

officialBoundaries.description: Up to 8 official transition times: each moves the boundary between session sessionIndex and the next to atSec, elapsed seconds from the file's first record. At most one per sessionIndex.

atSec.description: Official boundary time, seconds from the first record.

sessionIndex.description: Zero-based index of the session that ends at this boundary.

name: analyze_multisport
